summary: A Doha boutique law firm with a strong team list appears to lose enquiries to dead links, unproven claims and awkward copy.

findings.problem: About 13 links on the page appear to point to #.
findings.cost: Dead links stop visitors who want to read a practice area or reach the team.
findings.fix: Working links on every menu and section item.

findings.problem: The page title appears to call it Qatar's best law firm, with no rankings, reviews or case results shown.
findings.cost: An unproven best claim makes serious clients doubt the rest of the page.
findings.fix: Verified proof such as rankings, results and reviews.

findings.problem: Copy such as expert various business knowledge, alongside with, and a sentence starting That strives to appear.
findings.cost: Grammar errors on a legal site weaken trust in the firm's attention to detail.

findings.problem: The only contact path appears to be a generic Send Us Your Inquiries form and a phone link, with no WhatsApp.
findings.cost: Clients who message first go to a firm that answers on WhatsApp.
findings.fix: WhatsApp and a form with matter type.

redesign: WhatsApp and a clear enquiry form.
